review.method_name: Digital SSBI compensation schemes: single-stage, iterative and two-stage linearization filters, and SSBI estimation and cancellation
experimental_conditions: 7 x 25 Gb/s WDM SSB 16-QAM Nyquist-SCM direct-detection system
10 GHz WDM channel spacing and 3.43 GHz subcarrier frequency
80 km SSMF recirculating-loop spans; 240 km and 480 km transmission
BER over 2^18 bits; HD-FEC threshold BER = 3.8 x 10^-3
main_results: At HD-FEC back-to-back, two-stage linearization required 18.9 dB OSNR, a 6.4 dB gain over uncompensated reception
At 240 km, minimum BER decreased from 2.7 x 10^-3 without compensation to 1.0 x 10^-4 using SSBI estimation and cancellation
At 480 km, the two-stage linearization filter achieved the best BER of 2.6 x 10^-3
